allow: PowerShell(claude mcp add chrome-devtools -s user -- npx chrome-devtools-mcp@latest)

PowerShell($path = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude.json"; $json = Get-Content $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; if \(-not $json.mcpServers\) { $json | Add-Member -NotePropertyName mcpServers -NotePropertyValue \(New-Object PSObject\) -Force }; $json.mcpServers | Add-Member -NotePropertyName 'chrome-devtools' -NotePropertyValue \([PSCustomObject]@{ type='stdio'; command='npx'; args=@\('-y','chrome-devtools-mcp@latest'\) }\) -Force; \($json | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50\) | Set-Content -Path $path -Encoding UTF8; "added chrome-devtools MCP")
